title: A fermata on a whole note
description: One whole-note G4 with an event-level fermata carrying both optional refinements: symbol normal (the ordinary arc-and-dot) and duration long (a performance hint from the veryShort-to-veryLong enum). Fermatas can also sit on global measures and full-measure rests; the event form is the common case. Drawn since core-measure-attributes-gaps.md item 7: the plain sign 1.5 sp above the staff over the note; `duration` is a hint and changes no ink.
